_comment: Edit this file, then run: npm run settings:apply
_warning: Every value here is quoted to real customers as fact. Check each one.
deliveryAreas: Georgetown, East Bank Demerara, East Coast Demerara
_serviceArea: The same delivery area as a circle, checked against every location pin a customer shares. radiusKm 0 switches the check off and every pin is accepted. Get the shop's coordinates from Google Maps: right-click your shop, then click the numbers at the top of the menu to copy them.
_payment: What the driver can take. ["cash"] or ["cash","card"]. Never list something you cannot accept.
_money: Plain numbers in your display currency, not minor units. 500 means $500.
_staff: Who receives new-order alerts and can drive order status. E.164 digits, no '+'. Empty means nobody is told about orders.
_restricted: SKUs excluded from the catalogue. WhatsApp's Commerce Policy prohibits alcohol and tobacco; selling them can cost you the number.
_templates: Approved WhatsApp template names, used only outside the 24-hour service window. Leave empty until they are approved.
